services.name: Tandem Skydive
services.desc: You’ll jump from 10,000 feet, securely attached to one of our experienced tandem instructors, and freefall for over 5,000 feet at speeds up to 200 km/h. After that heart-pounding rush, your parachute opens and everything slows down - giving you a peaceful, scenic ride with incredible views of Strathcona Provincial Park, Campbell River, and the Comox Valley. Never skydived before? Perfect. Tandem is made for first-timers. You don’t need any prior experience - your instructor takes care of everything, guiding you through the process from start to finish and making sure it’s as safe and smooth as it is unforgettable.
